note: The clearsky window («Польовий КПК», the Clear Sky field PDA): a dark-blue PDA casing; the whole screen is the map (contour lines over a 64-unit grid) and the tree on it grows down, left of the card; three panels float over the map: the branch, the legend with the points, the node's card. Root TreeWindow fills the screen with the stage's colour; TreeStage is the mockup's 1600x900 stage, centred. Roles the menu fills are listed in source/ui/SKINS.md; numbers are the mockup's, measured in Chrome; every text's baseline is the mockup's.

panel.name: CsOutside
panel.note: Around the PDA on any screen (the stage is 1600 x 900 units, the screen wider): #stage's own colour, casing 40 % with #0b0b0a.

panel.name: CsTreeBg
panel.note: The map's ground: .tree's --lcd, under the scroll and the legend.

raw.name: TreeScroll
raw.note: The whole window is the map: .scroll of the tree at (12, 12), 34 above the legend strip. Drag it, or the wheel. The menu sizes TreeContent. Colour + style blank: the mockup's thumb (--cell-edge) on a dark track instead of the engine's white bar.

image.name: CsMap
image.note: The map itself (.content .bg): the screen's glow over the contour lines, stretched over the content as the CSS stretches them. The grid is the canvas's (GridStep 64).

panel.name: CsTiers
panel.note: The tier numerals (.tierlab: 13px, dim, letters spread, 44 wide from the map's left edge, centred): the window's OWN rows CsTierRow0..39, not the menu's -- on the stand (2026-10-31) CreateWidgets of ozl_clearsky_tier_label.layout handed back another skin's opens chip (layout mix-up R7). The skin (OnPaint) puts row i's corner on (0, the centre of the i-th tier) and shows the rows in use; the numeral's place in the row is the layout's (baseline 4.5 below the corner). A row is a 1-unit frame; the skin lifts its clipping and lets the mouse through it (ClearFlags CLIPCHILDREN, SetFlags IGNOREPOINTER -- what the menu does to its pooled rows): a clipping one shows a pixel slice of its label (skill gui-layouts). 40 rows: a tier is 1..40 (OZL_TreePlan.MAX_TIER); the skin counts the rows and logs a tree that has more tiers.

raw.name: TreeLines
raw.note: The 64-unit grid and every route, drawn by the menu.

image.name: CsFogStripes
image.note: The fog's 135-degree stripes, a pixel tile; the skin puts it on TreeFogEdge's rectangle, under it, where the fade lets them show.

label.name: TreeTipText
label.note: Wider than any tip on purpose: the menu sizes TreeTip from the text (GetTextSize) and TreeTip clips the rest.

frame.name: TreeLegend
frame.note: The legend strip at the foot of the map (.legend: 34 high, lcd, an edge line on top); the casing's dark band hides its last 10 units, as in the mockup.

panel.name: LegendRow
panel.note: Lined up by the menu (FlowLater from the skin's OnShow) by the width of each item's text plus 14, as the mockup's flex row with gap 14.

list.name: TreeTemplates
list.note: Holds no rows: it only declares the row files the menu creates outside a list primitive -- the label rows, and the rows of the card and the pool, whose scrolls are raw ScrollWidgets (a list cannot carry the scrollbar's colour). No tier_label: the tier numerals are this window's own CsTier labels.

row.name: OZL_ClearskyOrLabel
row.note: The widgets of BOTH the 'АБО' label and the price chip (engine layout mix-up R7, SKINS.md: CreateWidgets of one of two such paths has handed back the other file): whichever file arrives, the row works. A price row shows PriceChip + PriceText, OrText hidden (the price flow measures the first VISIBLE text); the skin's LabelTick shows OrText and hides the price parts on rows that sit directly in TreeNodes. Here: the 'АБО' beside an 'any' diamond, the mockup's text at (12, 4) from the diamond, 11px, coloured like its line by the menu.

row.name: OZL_ClearskyPriceChip
row.note: The widgets of BOTH the 'АБО' label and the price chip (engine layout mix-up R7, SKINS.md: CreateWidgets of one of two such paths has handed back the other file): whichever file arrives, the row works. A price row shows PriceChip + PriceText, OrText hidden (the price flow measures the first VISIBLE text); the skin's LabelTick shows OrText and hides the price parts on rows that sit directly in TreeNodes. Here: one part of a node's price (.price b + amount), a 7 x 7 square of the line's colour on the text's baseline and the amount 3 after it; the menu lines them up in NodePrice, 6 apart.

row.name: OZL_ClearskyPoolRow
row.note: One line of the pool (PoolList): its colour, its name, the number at the right; a zero is faint (the skin).

row.name: OZL_ClearskyCostRow
row.note: A cost line (.crow): its colour, the name, 'have / need' at the right, the bar under both; 8 of the column's gap at the bottom.

row.name: OZL_ClearskyOpensChip
row.note: A node this one opens (.opens a): text in a 1-unit edge, 8 of padding each side (text at 9, OpensPad 9); the edge is txt under the mouse (OnRowHover); a hidden node's chip has a dashed edge and faint text. The menu stretches ChipHit and the ...Line parts to the chip's width; the skin puts the right edge there and the rows 6 apart.

raw.name: ChipHit
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

frame.name: CsBranchFloat
frame.note: The branch panel: device name, branch name, faction and count (the mockup's branch list is display:none).

label.name: DevName
label.note: .dev: the skin writes it in capitals (its .14em spacing is narrower than an etelka space: dropped).

label.name: BranchName
label.note: .bname: in capitals (the skin; its .1em spacing is dropped).

label.name: CsBranchMark
label.note: Not in the mockup (one branch there): with several branches the skin puts it after the name, and a click on the name shows the next one.

raw.name: CsBranchNext
raw.note: With several branches: a click shows the next one (the skin's OnClick). style Empty.

raw.name: BtnClose
raw.note: Not in the mockup: a PDA's title line, so the word in the panel's top right corner, like the device name on the left. style Empty.

frame.name: CsPoolFloat
frame.note: The legend-and-points panel: the heading over the pool rows.

label.name: CsLegendHead
label.note: .h: in capitals, letters spread with spaces (.16em; the skin).

icon.name: CsLegendDash
icon.note: The .h's 1px dashed underline, as Chrome dashes it.

raw.name: PoolScroll
raw.note: The points (.pool: rows 25 high, 4 apart); a faction with more lines scrolls, its bar the mockup's thumb (colour + style blank). The 266-wide stack is the panel's content; the bar takes the 10 beside it.

frame.name: CsCardFloat
frame.note: The card panel: the node's card (inset 14/16, padding 4/2: content 354 x 736 from (19, 19)).

raw.name: CardScroll
raw.note: The card, top to bottom (.card: inset 14/16, padding 4/2, gap 10). The stack is the card's 354; a long card scrolls, its bar the mockup's thumb (colour + style blank) in the card's right margin. The rows (cost_row, opens_chip) are declared on TreeTemplates.

stack.name: CardName
stack.note: The name (.cname 21px, line 1.15): wrapped by the menu into its lines.

stack.name: CardDesc
stack.note: The description (.cdesc 14px, line 1.4, soft): wrapped by the menu into these lines (etelka is a bitmap face; one face for the whole window, as the howto asks).

frame.name: CardSegs
frame.note: The 20 segments of a running project (.pbar: 10 high, 2 apart), 8 under the time.

frame.name: CardOpensList
frame.note: The 'opens' chips (ozl_clearsky_opens_chip): the skin lines them up as the mockup does, 6 apart both ways, and sets the height.

frame.name: CardFoot
frame.note: .c-foot at the bottom of the card: the button and the reason under it.

panel.name: BtnResearchHover
panel.note: .go:hover: the button turns acc and its words screen; the menu shows this under the mouse while the button is enabled.

raw.name: BtnResearch
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

image.name: CsScan
image.note: #stage::after: light scanlines over the whole window, under the casing; a pixel tile.

panel.name: CsDarkT
panel.note: #stage::before's inset shadow of 12 under the 2-unit highlight: a dark band 10 wide around the screen.

panel.name: CsHiT
panel.note: The 2-unit highlight ring (--casing-hi) along the inside of the casing.

panel.name: CsCasingT
panel.note: The casing: a 10-unit frame of --casing, radius 14 (the corners are pictures, drawn after the bands). The side bands reach one unit under the bottom corners: ending exactly where they start left a pixel row of the outside colour (review 2026-10-31).
